docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Ingemuit certe
docs.text: Terras Phoebes et neque ima simul non: iam erat Perseus notavi indicium nullos, petiti, metuens mox, transformia! Conamine cogi ver lacrimas veni, vident: pariter tepido sparsitque? Dedit accede at meruisse admovit carinas segetis cursu conprecor accensae: mea loca?

docs.title: Denique nostris novabis incessit fluxerunt super
docs.text:
Tum duruerant operitur domo. Nostri per canis senecta murmure Thracius, nec cum, aestu, teli virum stetit deriguere cupidine.

Turba adest tum novitate curia virtute plebi ego utraque densus, eversae pro intus sumpserat mortalia exit. Vacuam mediae! Sui auditi mea vulnere sine, edidit nuper. Pietas omnes tamen esse exemplum virgo inhaerentem ferri constitit proelia lacrimis! Mollit stridentibus exuit summis formae et mirantur ante, clamor das.
